title: A $50 Billion Trader’s First Move on a Losing Position
description:
Build your first live trading algorithm 👉https://cryptomomentumgroup.com/

Steve Cohen runs $50 billion, and when a trade goes against him there's a sequence. First recheck your work and figure out what you might be missing, because you can't know everything. Only after all that work might he add to the position. Retail does it backwards, adding on emotion first and checking later, which is exactly the behavior rules-based systems remove.
